items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: I liked that cat, man. ... If I had to stay across the tracks, he'd go and stay across the tracks with me. Nobody else would do that.

ctx.x: really dug in the band, I mean, as far as being straight on the black-and-white thing, was Ray Biondi and Graham Young, really. But the rest of the cats was... No.
And Gene was... You were pretty tight before you joined the band.
